Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000209, which was taken on 2014-10-17. The claim amount is $3.68, but the retailer's POS supports $2.99 for this promotion. As per our records, we are required to repay $0.69. The dispute deadline was 2015-04-15, and this deadline has passed.

Please review the claim and provide your response.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
